ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $BD$ is the diameter of $\odot O$, with $A$ and $C$ on the circle. If $\angle A=50^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle DBC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that BD is the diameter of circle $O$,\\
it follows that $\angle BCD = 90^\circ$,\\
which implies $\angle D = \angle A = 50^\circ$,\\
thus, $\angle DBC = 90^\circ - \angle D = \boxed{40^\circ}$,
